situation: I have not been able to find a job

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi, how are you? What would you like to talk about today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hi! I have been feeling really sad the last couple of months!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I'm sorry to hear that! What do you think might be making you sad?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I haven't been able to find a decent job in a long time! I have great credentials but i doesn't matter what I do I never get called back!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Have you had someone take a look at your resume? Sometimes employers have their systems set up to cue on special terms and buzzwords. A resume consultant might be able to help with that.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I did it one time but it did not made a difference! I kept getting rejected from every company! It's like there is no place for me

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: if you have the qualifications, I'm sure that there is a job out there for you. How big a geographical area are you searching in?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I'm currently looking on the NYC area, because it's not an option to move out!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: NYC probably has lots of jobs but it's probably also a competitive place, with lots of skilled workers. What kind of job are you looking for?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I'm an Anaesthesiologist and i have a fellow on Regional Anaesthesia and Acute Pain Management

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Is it harder to find work because of the pandemic? This is an unusual situation for health care. Things might change for the labor market in the next few months.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes i know it has been difficult for everyone! I try to calm down and tell to myself that this are hard time for all of us and that i just have to keep going forward

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ok, how is your life going outside of the work search?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: My wife and I have been arguing a lot, she's pregnant and that makes the whole situation more difficult

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That's a challenging situation for anyone!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes I know! We've been able to keep things going because i had some savings and she is currently working at home! But expenses keep summing up

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Is there temporary work that you might be able to do from home for the time being? It might not pay as well as medicine, but it could help with the bills.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I haven't think about that option until now, I guess my mind was set on getting the job I've always dreamed of and didn't look at other options that might help my situation

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That's understandable. You've trained for a job and you want to get the job. I think that in the long term, you will be able to achieve that!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am! But for now I guess I will just focus on finding a job to help with the bill and keep trying as hard as I can to find a job on my field!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That's a great idea. I think that you can find something in the short-term. Companies are always looking for capable employees.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: You are completely right! You've been really helpful! I'm so glad i had this talk! I needed to vent and just have someone to listen to me!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I'm glad that I was able to help you! Have a great weekend, and best of luck with the job search.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you! Have a great weekend too! Thanks for your help!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Do you have a button on your end for ending the chat?
